long_description:

100,000+ drones, submarines, and satellites are being built in the US, but the legacy supply chain can't keep up. 
During our six years at Starlink, we put 5,000+ battery packs into space. Now, we're bringing rapid development and volume production of aerospace-grade battery packs to the entire industry.

launches.title: Kyten - The modern aerospace battery pack supplier
launches.body:
Hey everyone, we’re [Cooper](https://www.linkedin.com/in/cooper-mcbride/) and [Lucas](https://www.linkedin.com/in/lucasmaddox/) - cofounders of [Kyten Technologies](https://www.kytentech.com/)👋

### **TL;DR**

American manufacturers are racing to build 100,000+ autonomous vehicles for the air, sea, and space. Every vehicle needs a custom, aerospace-grade battery pack, but the supply chain delivering them is holding programs back. We’re changing that.

During our six years at **Starlink**, we put over 5,000 battery packs into space. Now, we’re bringing rapid development and volume production to the entire industry.

**_Ask_:** We have capacity for a few pilot customers—if you know any sea, air, or space manufacturers, please send them our way at [lucas.maddox@kytentech.com](mailto:lucas.maddox@kytentech.com).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97246&key=user_uploads/2153211/dad68a31-f6b9-4416-b89a-88ec56504144)

### 🐌 The aerospace supply chain is holding OEMs back

Every drone, submarine, and satellite needs a custom battery pack. But as demand grows into the tens of thousands per year, the supply chain is a generation behind:

* **6-12 months** to design and qualify custom builds.
* **6-12 months** to ramp to high volume production.
* **At least 5x** the cost of vertically integrating the product itself.

Forced vertical integration results in slower programs, higher costs, and significant delivery risk.

### 🛠️ Kyten builds aerospace battery packs fast and at high volume

We spent a combined eight years at **Starlink** and **Shield AI** driving down lead times and increasing production capacity of aerospace-grade battery packs. Kyten builds on this experience to deliver high volumes in weeks, not 12+ months:

* **1 week** to design via adaptive architecture.
* **1 week** to qualify via automated in-house testing.
* **1 week** to volume production via software-defined manufacturing.
* **1,000s of units/year** per product.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97246&key=user_uploads/2153211/0ec4b193-79f5-4f5d-ba72-6c8cd9bf1874)

Unlike the legacy aerospace supply chain, Kyten thinks like a modern manufacturer. If you, or anybody you know, needs custom aerospace-grade battery packs, please reach out at [lucas.maddox@kytentech.com](mailto:lucas.maddox@kytentech.com) 🦅
